notes: Depth panes: the 3D sky's depth chip shows the sky as glass shells at real log distances — Moon, Sun & planets, Oort cloud, nearby stars, constellation stars at their real (Hipparcos) distances, Milky Way, Local Group, galaxies, and the cosmic microwave background (Planck 2018). The pane stack travels; pinch/wheel move through it. Spread moves stars to their real distances: from the side Orion opens up. A tapped cell is the same place on every pane.

apk.notes: Offline shelf: Shelf › Download all puts the 30 public-domain books (1.49 GB) on your phone — pause, resume, delete, storage meter; books read with no network (airplane mode). Import your own PDFs privately (＋ Import PDF; stays on this phone).
